spine: 1. Big Pineapple（1.1.1.1 背後的快取層）任何時刻放著超過兩千五百億筆 DNS 快取項目，每筆浪費一個位元組就等於全艦隊多燒超過250GB——這個尺度讓逐欄位的記憶體優化變得值得做。
2. 第一刀：CacheEntry 的 8 個 Vec／String 欄位換成 Box<[T]>／Box<str>，砍掉快取寫入後就沒用的 capacity 欄位，每筆省 64 bytes，全艦隊 >15TB。
3. 第二刀：answer／authority／additional 三份各自獨立的紀錄清單合併成一份，用兩個 u16 位移取代兩組 8-byte 指標＋8-byte 長度，每筆省 28 bytes。
4. 第三刀：多數紀錄的 owner 就是查詢的 domain 本身，owner 欄位改成 Option<Box<Name>>，相同時存 None、讀取時從 qname 推回來，省掉一次 heap 配置。
5. 第四刀：RecordData enum 的大小本來被 NAPTR 136 bytes 的最大 variant 拖到 144 bytes，把大型 variant 包進 Box 後 A／AAAA 每筆省 120 bytes；代價是 allocator overhead 跟記憶體局部性變差，作者自己承認這個 tradeoff。
6. 第五刀：record data 不再解析成 enum，改存成帶 2-byte 長度前綴的原始 wire format bytes，查詢時對 A／AAAA／TXT／DNSSEC 直接複製，benchmark 裡插入吞吐+13%、查詢延遲再降5%。

7. 五刀疊加：benchmark 量到每筆淨佔用953B→420B(-56%)、配置量1.1KB→461B(-58%)、插入吞吐625k→893k/s(+43%)、查詢延遲828ns→670ns(-19%)；production 上線期（2026/5/18–7/6）量到 p99 記憶體9.3GB→5.3GB(-43%)、p90 6.5GB→3.8GB(-42%)，全艦隊約省100TB，Cloudflare 打算把這些記憶體重新投進快取容量而非縮編。

perspective.mechanism: 五個循序的 Rust 記憶體佈局優化——去掉 Vec/String 多餘的 capacity 欄位、把三份紀錄清單合併成一份配位移表、用 Option 省略跟查詢同名的 owner、選擇性 box enum 裡的大型 variant、以及把紀錄改存成未解析的 wire format bytes——疊加起來把 DNS 快取每筆項目的淨佔用砍 56%，同時插入吞吐與查詢延遲都變好。
perspective.tradeoff: Boxing 帶來 allocator overhead（jemalloc size class 捨入）跟記憶體局部性變差兩個代價，作者自己承認這不是無痛優化；benchmark 本身也只是近似 production 流量，跟艦隊尺度上約 100TB 的實測數字有量級但非精確對應的落差。
perspective.reader_use: 任何自己維護長駐、寫入後不再變動的快取資料結構的工程師，都可以照著這五刀的順序檢查自己的型別：Vec/String 有沒有必要保留 capacity、多份平行清單能不能合併成一份位移表、欄位是否可以從別的地方推算省略、enum 有沒有被單一大型 variant 拖累、以及儲存格式跟輸出格式是否可以直接對齊省掉序列化。

notes.quote: Big Pineapple, the platform behind 1.1.1.1, Gateway DNS, DNS Firewall, AS112, and several other Cloudflare DNS services, stores over 250 billion DNS cache entries at any given time. At that scale, wasting a single byte per entry costs more than 250 gigabytes of memory across our fleet.
notes.interpretation: 建立問題的尺度——快取條目數量本身就大到讓「每筆浪費一個位元組」變成有意義的優化目標，不是微觀優化。

notes.quote: Five successive changes to how cache entries are stored in memory cut the per-entry footprint by over 50%. Across our fleet, these changes freed up roughly 100 terabytes of memory, equivalent to the amount of RAM in 130 of our Gen 13 servers. The cache also got faster. Insert throughput rose 43% and lookup latency dropped 19%, as fewer allocations and better memory locality meant we did not trade speed for space.
notes.interpretation: 全文核心主張——五個改動疊加後同時省記憶體「與」加速，不是典型的空間換時間 tradeoff。

notes.quote: Each cache entry stores 8 Vec and String fields. Replacing them with Box<[T]> and Box<str> saves 8 bytes per field, 64 bytes per entry. It also eliminates the excess heap memory that Vec reserves for future growth. The combined savings add up to over 15 terabytes with over 250 billion cache entries.
notes.interpretation: Vec/String 保留 capacity 欄位是為了將來 push，但快取條目寫入後就不再變動，capacity 變成純粹的浪費——不可變資料結構場景下的典型優化。

notes.quote: This removes two lists, each with an 8-byte pointer and 8-byte length, and replaces them with two 2-byte offsets, saving 28 bytes per entry.
notes.interpretation: 前提是 DNS 每個 section 的紀錄數量本來就塞得進 u16，所以指標+長度的完整 fat pointer 是規格過剩。

notes.quote: Most records, however, have an owner identical to the queried domain. For those, we can drop the owner entirely and infer it at read time.
notes.interpretation: 用 Option<Box<Name>> 表示 owner，None 就代表跟查詢的 qname 一樣，把「大多數情況」直接編碼進型別，不必每筆都存一份重複的名稱。

notes.quote: For A and AAAA records, this saves 120 bytes per record. Smaller variant types like TXT and CNAME also benefit. They still occupy the 24-byte enum, but their heap allocation is sized to their actual data rather than padded to 144 bytes.
notes.interpretation: Rust enum 大小取決於最大的 variant；NAPTR 那顆 136 bytes 的 variant 把其他所有更小的 variant 一起拖到 144 bytes，boxing 只把「大隻的」搬到 heap，enum 本身縮回 tag 加指標大小。

notes.quote: Boxing has two costs. The first is allocator overhead... jemalloc rounds up to the nearest size class... The second cost is poor memory locality. Without boxing, the record enum values for a cache entry sit in a single contiguous allocation. With boxing, data for each boxed variant lives in a separate heap region.
notes.interpretation: 作者自己承認的 tradeoff——不是無痛優化，boxing 換來 allocator 開銷跟 cache locality 變差，只是在這個場景（多數紀錄是 A/AAAA）淨值仍是正的。

notes.quote: To build the record data buffer, we write into a reusable scratchspace buffer that persists across cache insertions...This replaces the separate allocation for each boxed record with one allocation for all record data...In our benchmark, this change alone increased cache insert throughput by 13%.
notes.interpretation: 從「每筆紀錄各自 boxed 配置」改成「整個 entry 共用一次配置」，把配置次數從 O(記錄數) 降到 O(1)，是 insert 吞吐提升的直接原因。

notes.quote: Combined with improved memory locality, this reduced cache lookup latency by 5% in our benchmarks.
notes.interpretation: 查詢時不用把每個欄位重新序列化回 wire format，A/AAAA/TXT/DNSSEC 都可以直接複製已經是 wire format 的 bytes。

notes.quote: Instead of a list of parsed enum variants, we store the records as a single Box<[u8]> containing each record encoded as a 2-byte length prefix followed by its raw bytes. Previously, each parsed record had to be serialized field by field back into DNS wire format. The new layout skips that work for A, AAAA, TXT, and all DNSSEC record types by copying their encoded bytes directly.
notes.interpretation: 把「先 parse 成 enum、查詢時再序列化回 wire format」整段省掉——快取本來就是要把 wire format 送回給 client，儲存格式跟輸出格式一致就不必來回轉換。

notes.quote: To measure the impact of each change, we benchmark by filling the cache with randomly generated entries that roughly match the traffic distribution we see in production: 56% A records, 25% AAAA, and 19% TXT. Each entry contains between one and four records.
notes.interpretation: benchmark 資料是模擬 production 流量分布生成的合成資料，不是直接重放真實流量，這點作者自己有揭露。Round-2 correction: this note previously spliced the two sentences below (n20) directly onto 'Each entry contains between one and four records.', dropping the TXT stand-in sentence and thereby changing the referent of 'Their'. The quote is now cut at the end of the sentence it can verbatim reach; the remainder lives in n20.

notes.quote: TXT records serve as a stand-in for all non-A/AAAA record types in the benchmark. Their size is randomized between 64 and 224 bytes, close to the average response size we see for variable-length record types.
notes.interpretation: 64–224 bytes 的隨機化只套用在那些代表所有非 A／AAAA 型別的 TXT 紀錄上，不是 benchmark 裡所有紀錄的通用大小範圍；「Their」指的是前一句的 TXT records。

notes.quote: Instances with fuller caches saw the largest absolute savings.
notes.interpretation: 文中唯一一句談節省在艦隊內部如何分布的話——講的是絕對量，而且明說快取愈滿的機器省得愈多，所以不能拿 p99／p90 降幅接近去推「節省均勻分布」。

notes.quote: Per-entry net footprint: 953 bytes to 420 bytes (-56%). Per-entry allocations: 1.1 KB to 461 bytes (-58%). Cache insert throughput: 625,000 entries/s to 893,000 entries/s (+43%). Cache lookup latency: 828 ns to 670 ns (-19%).
notes.interpretation: 五刀疊加後的 benchmark 總結——記憶體與速度同時改善的量化證據，是本文最核心的一組數字。

notes.quote: The first dashed line marks the start of the rollout on May 18, 2026, and the second marks its completion across all services on July 6, 2026. At p99, memory dropped from 9.3 GB to 5.3 GB, a 43% reduction in resident memory. At p90, memory dropped from 6.5 GB to 3.8 GB, a 42% reduction.
notes.interpretation: benchmark 的 43% 插入吞吐提升跟 production p99 的 43% 記憶體降幅不是同一個數字，只是量級接近，但兩者吻合代表 benchmark 沒有脫離真實機器上的行為。

notes.quote: We plan to reinvest the freed memory into increasing cache capacity without increasing our memory usage, which improves cache hit rates and reduces upstream query volume.
notes.interpretation: 省下的記憶體不是拿去關機省成本，是拿去擴大快取容量——DNS resolver 的典型槓桿：快取命中率漲一點，上游查詢量就降一點。

notes.quote: Big Pineapple uses jemalloc, an allocator designed for multithreaded, allocation-heavy workloads. jemalloc groups allocations of similar sizes into fixed-size bins. A TXT record requests 32 bytes and fits exactly into a 32-byte bin, wasting nothing, but an MX record requests 40 bytes and rounds up to 48, wasting 8 bytes.
notes.interpretation: jemalloc 的 bin 機制解釋了 boxing 的 allocator overhead 代價。Round-2 correction: 原本的 interpretation 寫「小物件配置多了浪費比例更高」，但來源沒有這個結論——它給的兩個例子反而是 32-byte 的 TXT 一個 byte 都沒浪費、40-byte 的 MX 浪費 8 bytes，捨入是否剛好落在邊界要看實際大小。

notes.quote: DNSSEC records are only included when the client sets the DO (DNSSEC OK) flag. Storing a complete wire format message means either caching two variants, one with DNSSEC and one without, or filtering them out.
notes.interpretation: 解釋了為什麼他們沒有直接快取「一整包組好的 wire format 回應」——DNSSEC 的條件式回應讓那條路要嘛存兩份、要嘛每次 filter，他們選擇拆到單筆紀錄層級的 wire format 化。

notes.quote: We track memory usage using a custom allocator that wraps Rust's System allocator and records the number and size of allocations per cache entry.
notes.interpretation: 量測方法本身值得注意——包一層 allocator 蒐集配置次數與大小，而不是只看 process RSS，才量得出「每筆項目的配置量少了 58%」這種細粒度數字。Round-2 correction: 原本寫「配置次數少了 58%」，但 -58% 是配置「量」（1.1 KB → 461 bytes），來源沒有給配置次數的降幅。

notes.quote: These inputs approximate production rather than reproduce it exactly. Process memory also depends on traffic mix, cache occupancy, allocator state, and memory used outside the cache.
notes.interpretation: 作者自己承認 benchmark 是近似值——這也是「把每筆節省的 bytes 直接乘上艦隊快取筆數」外推出來的數字，不會剛好等於實測 100TB 的原因。

notes.quote: CacheKey fields: qname, qtype, authenticated, tag. CacheEntry original fields: timestamp, inception, ttl, hits, answers (Vec<Record>), authority (Vec<Record>), additional (Vec<Record>), errors (Vec<ExtendedError>).
notes.interpretation: 來自文中程式碼區塊列出的結構定義而非行文敘述——用來說明「8 個 Vec/String 欄位」具體是哪些欄位，以及哪些純量欄位不在這次優化範圍內。

claims.claim_text: 三份清單原本各自獨立配置；文章沒有交代這一刀對配置次數的影響，合理的推測是合成一份連續陣列之後，配置次數也跟著從三次降到一次

claims.claim_text: jemalloc 把大小相近的配置歸進固定尺寸的 bin：一筆 TXT 紀錄要 32 bytes，剛好落進 32-byte 的 bin，一個 byte 都沒浪費；但一筆 MX 紀錄要 40 bytes，就被捨入到 48，白白多佔 8 bytes
claims.location: H2「Boxing 的算盤」— boxing 代價段
claims.evidence: Big Pineapple uses jemalloc, an allocator designed for multithreaded, allocation-heavy workloads. jemalloc groups allocations of similar sizes into fixed-size bins. A TXT record requests 32 bytes and fits exactly into a 32-byte bin, wasting nothing, but an MX record requests 40 bytes and rounds up to 48, wasting 8 bytes.
claims.note: The jemalloc/size-class/rounding mechanism is supported, but two sub-claims are not. (a) 「很少剛好卡在某個 size class 的邊界」 is contradicted by the source's own worked example — a TXT record 'fits exactly into a 32-byte bin, wasting nothing'. (b) 「浪費比例對小物件更明顯」 is nowhere stated; the source gives one example of zero waste on a 32-byte object and 8 bytes of waste on a 40-byte object, and draws no proportional-by-size conclusion. Correct to what the source says (bins + the 32/40→48 example). ／ 修正：the 「很少剛好卡在邊界」 assertion, contradicted by the source's own zero-waste TXT example, was replaced with the source's two worked examples verbatim in substance (TXT 32 bytes into a 32-byte bin wasting nothing; MX 40 bytes rounded to 48, wasting 8 bytes). The unsupported 「浪費比例對小物件更明顯」 conclusion was moved into the following paragraph and demoted to marked inference（「捨入的損失是否對小物件更傷，Cloudflare 沒有寫；不過照…推算」）. n15's quote was extended to the full contiguous source paragraph so the bin examples are now backed by a verbatim note.

claims.claim_text: 第二個代價是記憶體局部性變差：沒有 boxing 時，一筆快取項目的所有 record enum 值擠在同一塊連續配置裡；boxing 之後，每個被 box 的 variant 各自活在獨立的 heap 區域
claims.location: H2「Boxing 的算盤」— boxing 代價段
claims.evidence: The second cost is poor memory locality. Without boxing, the record enum values for a cache entry sit in a single contiguous allocation. With boxing, data for each boxed variant lives in a separate heap region.
claims.note: Found verbatim; the post is a faithful translation including the 'two costs' framing.

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare 沒有迴避這個 tradeoff，但也沒有把淨值算給讀者看；照 A、AAAA 在 benchmark 流量裡佔了 56% 加 25%、每筆省下 120 bytes 推算，合理的判斷是 padding 省下的空間大於 boxing 付出的代價
claims.location: H2「Boxing 的算盤」— boxing 代價段結尾

The intensifier 「遠大於」 was softened to 「大於」.

claims.claim_text: 文章也沒有交代 A、AAAA 為什麼繼續留在 enum 裡不裝箱；合理的推測是，這種天生只有 4 到 16 bytes 的 variant 若也跟著裝箱，每一筆都要付一次獨立配置與捨入的代價，很可能反過來吃掉 boxing 原本要省下的 padding

The clause's second half is hedged (「很可能」), but the framing 「這也是為什麼」 asserts the causal explanation as the source's, which it is not. ／ 修正：the asserted 「這也是為什麼」 framing was deleted and replaced with an explicit statement that the article gives no reason（「文章也沒有交代…」）plus 「合理的推測是」. The 4–16 byte figures added are the source's own A/AAAA sizes (verified under c15).

claims.claim_text: record data 不再是一串 parsed enum variant，而是塞進單一 Box<[u8]>，每筆紀錄前面加一個 2-byte 長度前綴，後面接著原始 bytes……新的佈局讓 A、AAAA、TXT 跟所有 DNSSEC 紀錄類型直接複製已經是 wire format 的 bytes

claims.evidence: Instead of a list of parsed enum variants, we store the records as a single Box<[u8]> containing each record encoded as a 2-byte length prefix followed by its raw bytes. Previously, each parsed record had to be serialized field by field back into DNS wire format. The new layout skips that work for A, AAAA, TXT, and all DNSSEC record types by copying their encoded bytes directly.
claims.note: Found verbatim, including the exact record-type list.

claims.claim_text: 這一刀在 benchmark 裡讓查詢延遲降了 5%，插入吞吐單獨提升 13%（widget：插入 +13%．延遲 −5%）

claims.claim_text: 這裡的 TXT 是 benchmark 裡所有非 A／AAAA 紀錄型別的代表，大小在 64 到 224 bytes 之間隨機，貼近他們在 production 觀察到的變長紀錄平均回應大小

The post inherits that elision and asserts a general per-record size range the source does not state. This is the one note whose quote is NOT verbatim: it is a cross-paragraph splice with meaning-bearing text removed. ／ 修正：the range is now scoped to the TXT records that stand in for all non-A/AAAA types, as the source states, instead of being presented as a general per-record size. Mark as inference, and check the claim against that sentence when fixing. ／ 修正：and reconciled with the source — 「代表這五刀帶來的節省均勻分布在整個艦隊」 was deleted. The paragraph now quotes the article's own and only fleet-distribution sentence（'Instances with fuller caches saw the largest absolute savings'）, states plainly that similar percentage drops do not mean savings are spread evenly per machine, and marks the reconciliation (fixed per-entry bytes × entry count → larger absolute savings on fuller machines) as the post's own reasoning with 「合理的推測是」. New note n21 carries that sentence verbatim.

claims.claim_text: 把每筆項目省下的 533 bytes 直接乘上兩千五百億筆項目，粗算會超過 130TB
claims.location: 收尾段與 .vg-w-range-fleet-math widget
claims.evidence: Per-entry net footprint | 953 bytes | 420 bytes | -56% / stores over 250 billion DNS cache entries at any given time
claims.note: The article performs no such multiplication and states no 130 TB figure. The post marks it as its own arithmetic (「粗算」) and immediately contrasts it with the published 「roughly 100 terabytes」, which is the correct handling for a marked inference, so no action. Arithmetic re-checked and correct: 953 − 420 = 533 bytes per entry; 533 × 250e9 = 1.33e14 bytes ≈ 133 TB decimal, i.e. 「超過 130TB」. The widget's formula (billions × 533 / 1000) reproduces the same result at the default 250. The gap-explanation sentence is properly grounded in n18.
